name: Polish VAT Number (VAT-UE)
description: Validates Polish VAT identification numbers (VAT-UE / NIP do celów VAT). Matches standard 10-digit NIP numbers with optional or required 'PL' country prefix and official Polish hyphenation formats.
seoTitle: Polish VAT (VAT-UE / NIP) Regex — Validate Polish VAT Number
seoDescription: Regex pattern for validating Polish VAT (VAT-UE) numbers with optional PL prefix and hyphenation. Ready-to-use code in TypeScript, Go, Python, PHP, and Rust.
